description: Ania Studio makes YouTuber-style videos about the user’s app, narrated by their own Ania avatar. A project is the series (brand, avatar, voice); each episode is one video with an Ania Script (titulo + cenas). Lists the user’s projects with their episodes and the latest version of each. Free.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.
